entities.name: CreC (Q9P4R5)
observations: Reviewed Emericella nidulans protein; the query sequence is an exact 592-aa sequence match (100% identity and coverage).
Functions in carbon-source regulation through ubiquitination/deubiquitination; prevents proteolysis of CreB and supports expression of proline and quinate pathway genes.
Annotated to cytoplasm and nucleus; GO includes deubiquitinase activator activity and carbon catabolite repression of transcription.
Pfam scan detected an ANAPC4_WD40 region at residues 323–379 and weaker WD40 matches; no catalytic reaction was retrieved.

entities.name: CreB deubiquitinase
observations: Interacts with fungal CreC; CreC is required to prevent CreB proteolysis in the cited annotated regulatory system.

entities.name: Carbon catabolite regulation
observations: CreC participates in an ubiquitination/deubiquitination regulatory network controlling carbon-source utilization and expression of proline and quinate pathway genes.
